verdict.rationale: Khoj documents fully local operation. It supports offline chat models, local LLMs such as llama3, qwen and gemma, and Ollama through its local OpenAI-compatible server. It also generates embeddings on-device and can be used without an internet connection when self-hosted; cloud API keys are optional and only needed for commercial models. Older community reports that chat required OpenAI come from an earlier launch thread and are superseded by later developer experiments with Llama V2/GPT4All and by the current Ollama docs, though users note small local models struggle with notes context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of llama.cpp, LM Studio and vLLM backends, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully offline chat setup working well.
